product_metadata.title: Totally Bamboo Salt Cellar Bamboo Storage Box with Magnetic Swivel Lid, 6 Ounce Capacity, "Salt" Engraved on Lid
features: BEAUTIFUL AND FUNCTIONAL: Keep table salt, gourmet salts, herbs or seasonings close at hand in this bamboo salt box with "Salt" beautifully engraved on the lid
SMART DESIGN: Lid shuts firmly closed with a magnetic lock; swivels open easily with just one hand for adding spices in a pinch while cooking
LASER-ENGRAVED ARTWORK: There's no doubt about what's in this box with "Salt" permanently laser etched in the lid
SPECIALTY SALT STORAGE: This beautifully crafted salt box is the perfect place to store your favorite gourmet and specialty salts
EASY CARE: Simply hand wash or wipe with a damp cloth; do not soak in water or wash in the dishwasher
